parts.label: cabinet body
parts.appearance: hollow rectangular box with thick flat top and bottom panels, vertical side walls and a back panel, open toward the front, with a horizontal divider at upper mid height

parts.label: upper drawer front
parts.appearance: wide thin rectangular panel with slightly softened edges, mounted vertically across the upper front opening of the cabinet

parts.label: drawer round knob
parts.appearance: small round cylindrical knob with a broad circular face and short narrow stem, projecting forward from the center of the upper drawer front

parts.label: front left leg
parts.appearance: tapered cylindrical post with rounded flat foot, splaying slightly outward and extending down from the front left corner of the cabinet bottom

parts.label: rear left leg
parts.appearance: tapered cylindrical post with rounded flat foot, splaying slightly outward and extending down from the rear left corner of the cabinet bottom

parts.label: front right leg
parts.appearance: tapered cylindrical post with rounded flat foot, splaying slightly outward and extending down from the front right corner of the cabinet bottom

parts.label: rear right leg
parts.appearance: tapered cylindrical post with rounded flat foot, splaying slightly outward and extending down from the rear right corner of the cabinet bottom
